title: Data Engineer / Data Analyst
description:
Job Summary 
 Are you passionate about turning raw data into actionable insights and scalable solutions We are looking for a Data Engineer / Data Analyst with 2+ years of experience to join our growing data team. Location: Porvorim, Goa Employment Type: Full-time 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, build, and maintain efficient data pipelines and ETL workflows. Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to uncover insights that drive business decisions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, business) to understand data requirements. Develop dashboards and visualizations to communicate key metrics and trends. Ensure data accuracy, quality, and security across systems. 
 
 Requirements 
 2+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Data Analyst. Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with Python or R for data manipulation. Hands-on experience with ETL tools, data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), or cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure). Good understanding of data modeling, data pipelines, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker). Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and communication skills. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with big data frameworks (Spark, Hadoop). Familiarity with machine learning or statistical analysis. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git). 
 
 Why Join Us 
 Opportunity to work on impactful data projects and modern data tech stacks. Collaborative, growth-oriented culture. Competitive compensation and benefits. 

Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
